# Agentbeats Lambda (Vendor Copy)

This directory is a vendor copy of the official `LambdaLabsML/agentbeats-lambda` repository at the pinned commit recorded in `COMMIT_PIN.txt`.

## Read-only policy
Do not modify vendor code for Purple Vanguard logic. Treat this folder as a read-only mirror of upstream.

## How to update
1. Re-copy the upstream repository at a newer commit into this directory.
2. Update `COMMIT_PIN.txt` with the new pinned commit metadata.

## Purpose
Provide a deterministic, reproducible local mirror harness for evaluation and scoring.
